summary: The prepared main checkout already contains upstream PR #35228: compressed-tensors name-targeted ParallelLMHead instances resolve to CompressedTensorsLinearMethod, create/load channel weight_scale, and route logits through quant_method.apply. No additional production correction was justified.

tests.what_was_measured: Nine issue-specific regression and independent boundary tests: regex/exact/dotted target resolution, ignored/module-only/unnamed unquantized controls, explicit block-scale rejection, quantized dispatch, and unquantized fallback.

Actual gfx950 CompressedTensorsW8A8Fp8 lm_head execution versus an independent PyTorch dequantize-then-matmul reference: cosine 0.9996408, top-1 17/17, while ignoring per-channel scales reduced cosine to 0.6587629.

gpu_execution.evidence: Single AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 execution; reports/j-eca615945d43/gpu_fp8_lm_head_check.txt retains device, dispatch, scale shape, and numerical results.

remaining_limitations: The unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4 weights and the reported 2x RTX 5090 SM120 environment were unavailable. No full-model generation, semantic-accuracy, TP=2, CUDA/SM120, or HTTP serving claim is made. The gfx950 fixture validates dispatch, scale retention, and FP8 engine execution only.
